subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should Copilot BYOK enforce the proposed unconditional 16 MiB body limit and 30-second body-read deadline for all existing local SDK traffic?
rationale: The patch is a focused fix, but the new thresholds define a compatibility contract for existing BYOK clients; repository policy treats provider and fallback behavior as upgrade-sensitive when users may discover the change only at runtime.

options.title: Adopt the shared ingress limits

options.title: Use a Copilot-specific compatibility boundary
options.body: Adjust the limits or make the stricter behavior opt-in if established Copilot BYOK traffic can legitimately exceed the proposed thresholds.
